title: Common-stage operation shift and exactness data
statement: For any common-stage operation witnesses H, G, RH and RG in the setting of the parent lemma, there exist commutation-with-shifts structures for both framework and PBC operations such that all additive, triangulated, compatible-transformation, and finite-stage shift equations in the parent Result hold.

proof.text: The statement is the corresponding operation or shift component of the common-stage construction; the parent combines it with the other component.
